scope: Curated research corpus; live db_schema supplies authoritative columns and foreign keys.

tables.publications_disease: Disease codes and names; filter code such as MSL3.
tables.publications_publication: Publication records. Count DISTINCT id. corpus_excluded marks corpus membership; needs_review is independent.
tables.publications_publication_sources: Many-to-many publication/source membership; source counts can overlap.
tables.publications_clinical_trial: Stored clinical-trial snapshots; status is not a live registry check.

query_guidance: Join publication_diseases.publication_id to publication.id and disease_id to disease.id.
Report overall and corpus_excluded = false counts separately. Exclusion is not a quality judgment.
